name: Poisoned Cake
source:
In the stillness of the academy, how does a quiet afternoon unfold into days of shadow and longing? A photographer with gentle eyes. A cook with a warm smile.

But love has strange ingredients. Are you ready to taste them?

[From [url=https://manon-odyaka.itch.io/poisoned-cake]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
寂静的书院里，安静的午后如何变成阴影与思念的日子？眼神温柔的摄影师。笑容温暖的厨师。

但爱情有奇怪的成分。你准备好品尝它们了吗？

[来自[url=https://manon-odyaka.itch.io/poisoned-cake]Itch.io[/url]]
